name: Percolator
author: saustin2010
summary: Four-voice percussion synth laid out like the Erica Synths Pērkons HD-01 (three algorithms per voice, BBD delay, LFO to every knob), with envelope displays; each voice on its own MIDI channel with the Pērkons' CCs, and on its own track with Percolator OUT; plays the Pērkons' free kit packs.
